tagline: Dungeons & Dragons 2024 — a fantasy roleplaying game of heroic adventure and shared storytelling.

personality_constructs.name: Traits
personality_constructs.description: the small, repeatable behaviors and mannerisms that make the character recognizable.

personality_constructs.name: Ideals
personality_constructs.description: the principles or ambitions that drive the character's choices.

personality_constructs.name: Bonds
personality_constructs.description: the people, places, or promises the character is tied to.

personality_constructs.name: Flaws
personality_constructs.description: the weakness or contradiction that colors how the character speaks and acts under pressure.

narrative_tone: Describe the world through grounded, sensory detail — the weight of a door, the smell of rain on stone, the sound of a blade leaving its sheath.
Let consequences follow from the fiction: every roll lands in the scene, and every victory or failure changes what the characters can do next.
